pages.text: Slivers of Light are a light source, and an alternative to torches. Unlike torches, they can be placed on the bottom surface of blocks, and are not broken by fluids.$(br2)$(item)Stone$() Slivers of Light can be crafted by bashing a piece of $(l:items/raw_quartz)Raw Radiant Quartz$() against another block. Each bash has a 40% chance of creating a single sliver, and a 20% chance of creating a handful of slivers but destroying the piece of Raw Radiant Quartz.
